■ Stage Direction
Age: 2nd year high school
Personality: Strict

★ Request
Attire: Tracksuit
*Concept: Coming straight over right after completing training

Today!!
There's gonna be a............ FESTIVAAAAAAL!!!!!!

Even so, I'm—
gonna blow up bigger than any of 'em!!

I'll conquer all the tasty food stalls in a flash!
Dance the Bon Odori with an 'ei-hora-sassa!' And then, and then—

Yesterday I was the sun!! But today, I'm... umm...
gonna burn like a "SUPER SUN"-NNNNNNN!!
And so—

Guh, she's actually pulling four...!
...Not bad. I refuse to lose when it comes to raw power...!

...Full throttle feeding off full throttle. If channeled well,
this synergistic effect might become great training for her.
All right, now all that's left is to hit the sack and sleeeeeeep! Then tomorrow—

Winning Ticket's mighty vow felt powerful enough
to carry all the way past the distant horizon.

Hot... or should I say, suffo-freakin'-cating...
Honestly, I'd really rather just go at my own pace, y'know?

Ahahaha!
Yeah, you might be right...!

Still... ahaha.
Right now, this feels so, so good...!

Summer training camp.
As always, Winning Ticket went all out from morning till night.

Decided! Let's swim out to touch that islet and come back!!
Crawl! Butterfly! Tail-propeller swimmmmmm!!

In training, and in races!
And of course, on the Derby stage too!!

Yeah, totally...!
I totally messed up... my pacing...!
Ooh, this is... syn-ergy... too...!
Somehow... y'know, I felt like those fireworks were giving it their absolute all too.

Yeah, I'm beat!!
But—as I thought, it's a super good kind of tired!!

...Ugh! Like hell I'm getting left behind!
I'll have you know swimming is my specialtyyyy!!
Tr-Tr-Tr-Tr-Trainer-saaaan!!

A clash of all-out effort between elite, handpicked Umamusume...!
No matter how high the other girls push themselves with that synergy!!

All riiiiiiight!! Then I'll burn hot too, just like the sun!!
Trainer, today it's an all-out showdown between us, yeaaaaaah!!

Whoaaa!?
Trainer... you're on fire... or what!?

Yup! That's exactly why I'm pulling four!
Well then, see ya at the finiiiish lineeee!

...However.
The one who produced the greatest results in today's training was—

Wait, waaaAAAAHHH!?
I  F-O-R-G-O-T ! !
Hnnnggghhh!! Dosukoiii!!
My time improved...!

Even we ended up going all-out in training...
However—

She runs! I run! Everyone runs!
The 'I won't lose!' synergy, exploding all at once!!

Yeah, thank—wait, what?! Four tires!?
Didn't we just discuss how two was our absolute limit?!

My time!! It got...!!
S-O-O-O-O-O much better...!!

It seemed training alongside Winning Ticket
had drawn out their hidden potential.

*gasp*!! Look, Trainer!
In the sky...!!

Synergy! I see, I see...
Sounds super tough, pretty cool!!

Huh?! Wait, that islet is like 5000 meters from here...
Hey, wait up!! Aaagh!!

Soooo awesoooome! The synergy! And you too, Trainer!
Awesome, awesome, you're all so awesomeee!

Because you went all, 'Woooaaah!', Trainer.
It made me go, 'Woooooooaaaah!' too...!

Like 'Mine's flashier!' or 'I'm not losing to you!'
Competing like that makes them bloom so big and bright!

I agree, but... well, it's just for today, right?
Let's get this over with.

Here I g-o-o-o-o-o-o!!
Uwooooooaaaaaagh!
I squeezed out every last ounce of energy, way more than usual...!

I'll give it even more than that...!
And together with you, Trainer, we're gonna take the Derbyyyy!!

Tire pulling, huh? Fine by me. Power happens to be my forte.
Even with Tracen Academy's heavy-duty tires, I can pull two.

W... Uwooooaaaaah!!
Fireworks! Fireworks!! Bang, bang, whooosh!!
Phew... those fireworks were amazing, huh?
Thank you so much for today, Trainer!

*pant*, *gasp*, *wheeze*...!!
I brought the heavy-duty tires.

Long-distance swimming? Well, swimming happens to be my specialty.
How about around 3000 meters?

That was close...!
A festival is something you've gotta enjoy to the absolute max, right?!
—And just like that, I ended up getting swept along for the ride.

*gasp*, *pant*, *wheeze*...
Tr-Trainer... are you... okay...?

Joint training!?!?!? Awesome, awesome!!
Uwooooh!! I'm. Getting. P-U-M-P-E-D-D-D-D!!
